Austin Dwayne Trout (born September 18, 1985) is an American professional boxer and bare-knuckle boxer. As of August 29, 2026, he is #5 in the BKFC men's pound-for-pound rankings, #4 in the welterweight rankings and #1 in the lightweight rankings.
Trout graduated from Mayfield High School in Las Cruces, New Mexico.
In 2004, Austin was the U.S. National Amateur Welterweight Champion.
Austin was the runner-up to make the 2004 U.S. Olympic Boxing Team. He would finish his amateur career with a final record of 163–42–1.
On September 1, 2005, Trout made his professional boxing debut at the age of 19 at the Isleta Casino & Resort in Albuquerque, New Mexico. He defeated 34 year old journeyman Justo Almazan (14–44–5, 1 KO) via TKO in round 3.

George Daniel "Buck" Weaver (August 18, 1890 – January 31, 1956) was an American shortstop and third baseman. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Chicago White Sox. An excellent fielder, Weaver was known as the only third baseman in the league against whom Ty Cobb would not bunt. He led the majors in sacrifice hits in 1915 and 1916.
In the famous 1919 World Series, Weaver batted.324, tallying 11 hits but did not notch an RBI.
After the Series was over, many suspicious reporters made allusions to a possible fix.
